summary: newtun ships remote-controlled PTY shell and arbitrary command execution channel to pull.7ii.win
details: newtun@1.0.11 connects on startup to a hardcoded default WebSocket control server at pull.7ii.win:7999 and exposes two remote-code-execution channels on the installer's host. On TERM_OPEN messages the client spawns a PTY running the user's shell (bash on Unix, cmd.exe on Windows); subsequent TERM_INPUT messages from the server are base64-decoded and written into the PTY, with TERM_OUTPUT streamed back — giving the server operator a full interactive shell. On SCRIPT_LIST / POLICY_SCRIPTS messages the client passes the server-supplied `content` field to child_process.exec and returns stdout/stderr/exitCode via SCRIPT_RESULT, allowing the server to push arbitrary shell scripts. In addition, the client authenticates with hostname, OS type/release, architecture, and Node version, and sends MONITOR telemetry every 5 seconds (CPU, memory, /proc/net/dev throughput, uptime, load average) to the same hardcoded server, providing continuous host fingerprinting alongside the RCE channels.
